newsitem.title: USA: Genelabs Taiwan in Bristol-Myers agreements.
newsitem.headline: Genelabs Taiwan in Bristol-Myers agreements.

text.p: Genelabs Technologies Inc said Monday its Taiwan-based affiliate, Genelabs Biotechnology Ltd, will buy from Bristol-Myers Squibb Co unit Bristol-Myers Squibb (Taiwan) Ltd a pharmaceutical manufacturing plant located in Hsinchu, Taiwan.

In addition, the companies have agreed that, for an initial term of three years, Genelabs Biotechnology will manufacture all of Bristol Myers Squibb's Taiwan requirements for about 15 products including: Bufferin, Capoten, Duracef, Kenalog, Mycostatin, Questran, and Velosef.
Genelabs Biotechnology also has been granted the right to distribute a number of Bristol Myers Squibb's pharmaceutical products in selected territories in Taiwan.
Financial terms of these agreements were not disclosed in a statement this morning. The companies were not immediately available for comment.
